title: The Estate | Lake Views w/Heated Pool, Spa, & Boat
description: Escape to this expansive lakeside estate in Glendale's Arrowhead Lakes community, where a resort-style heated infinity pool, private spa, and your own pontoon boat set the tone for the stay. Spread across multiple wings, the home comfortably sleeps up to 15 guests with dual primary suites, a guest casita, and a great room built for gathering. Minutes from State Farm Stadium, Spring Training ballparks, and downtown Glendale's dining scene — this is Arizona living at its most relaxed.
